notes: CFRU + Dynamic Pokemon Expansion bundle. No patch binary ships in this repository: run scripts/build-cfru-bundle-with-dpe.mjs against your own CFRU and DPE clones plus your own legally-obtained FireRed (USA v1.0) ROM to produce dpe.bps, then update the fingerprint at engine/src/identity/hack-fingerprints.ts with the SHA-1 the script reports. Both CFRU and DPE are non-commercial; honor Skeli789's license terms (no monetization).
